prompt.en: How did the peoples of the West Coast preserve fish?
prompt.fr: Comment les peuples de la côte Ouest conservaient-ils le poisson?

options.fr: En le faisant sécher et en le fumant.
En le salant dans des barils.

options.en: By freezing it in ice houses.
options.fr: En le congelant dans des glacières.

options.en: By trading it away the same day.

explanation.en: West Coast peoples preserved fish by drying and smoking it. Each region had its own way of living from the land and the sea.
explanation.fr: Les peuples de la côte Ouest conservaient le poisson en le faisant sécher et en le fumant. Chaque région avait sa propre façon de vivre de la terre et de la mer.

source.quote: West Coast natives preserved fish by drying and smoking.

verification.evidence: The native people lived off the land, some by hunting and gathering, others by raising crops. … The Inuit lived off Arctic wildlife. West Coast natives preserved fish by drying and smoking.
